# ATTC — Advance Training & Testing Center
# llms.txt — Structured AI Summary for Search Engines (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity)
# Format: Markdown for AI consumption

## Organization

**Name**: Advance Training And Testing Center (ATTC)
**Type**: Vocational / Technical Training Center
**ISO Certified**: Yes
**Part of**: Catharsis Group
**Website**: https://www.attc.school
**Location**: 2185/A, Block-I (Extension), Bashundhara C/A, Madani Avenue, Dhaka-1229, Bangladesh
**Phone**: +8801335143359
**Email**: info@attc.school

## Mission

ATTC is dedicated to bridging the gap between education and industry needs by providing ISO-certified, hands-on vocational training in construction trades. The center equips individuals with practical skills for both local and international employment.

## Campus & Facilities

- **Campus Size**: 6 bigha plot of land
- **Accommodation**: Up to 200 students in on-campus hostel
- **Canteen**: Skilled chefs, capacity 100+ persons
- **Internet**: High-speed Wi-Fi across campus
- **Power**: 24/7 electricity backup
- **Security**: CCTV monitoring and on-site security
- **Prayer Room**: Available for students
- **Testing Labs**: Trade-wise testing and assessment facilities

## Courses Offered

### 1. Plasterer
- **Category**: Construction Trade
- **Description**: Professional plastering using cement, gypsum, and lime on walls, ceilings, and surfaces. Covers base coats, finishing coats, decorative plastering, skim coating, and repairs.
- **Modules**: Introduction, Surface Preparation, Plastering Techniques, Advanced Skills, Safety, Practical Application
- **Certification**: ATTC Plasterer Certificate
- **Career Paths**: Professional Plasterer, Contractor, Site Supervisor, International construction jobs
- **URL**: https://www.attc.school/courses/plasterer.html

### 2. Tiler
- **Category**: Construction Trade
- **Description**: Professional tile installation on floors, walls, kitchens, bathrooms, and outdoor areas. Covers ceramic, porcelain, mosaic, marble, and granite tiles.
- **Modules**: Introduction, Surface Preparation, Tile Installation, Grouting & Finishing, Advanced Skills, Safety
- **Certification**: ATTC Tiler Certificate
- **Career Paths**: Professional Tiler, Interior Finishing Technician, Self-Employed Contractor, Overseas jobs
- **URL**: https://www.attc.school/courses/tiler.html

### 3. Formwork Carpentry
- **Category**: Carpentry Trade
- **Description**: Constructing, installing, and dismantling concrete formwork systems for slabs, beams, columns, and walls. Covers timber, metal, and modular systems.
- **Modules**: Introduction, Blueprint Reading, Formwork Design, Assembly, Dismantling, Advanced Techniques, Safety
- **Certification**: ATTC Formwork Carpentry Certificate
- **Career Paths**: Formwork Carpenter, Site Supervisor, Project Manager, International construction
- **URL**: https://www.attc.school/courses/formwork-carpentry.html

### 4. Bar Bending
- **Category**: Structural Trade
- **Description**: Steel rebar cutting, bending, and tying for reinforced concrete. Covers rebar types, bending schedules, machine use, and reinforcement layout.
- **Modules**: Introduction, Rebar Types, Bending Techniques, Cutting & Handling, Tying & Layout, Safety
- **Certification**: ATTC Bar Bending Certificate
- **Career Paths**: Bar Bender, Reinforcement Worker, Steel Fixer, Foreman, International jobs
- **URL**: https://www.attc.school/courses/bar-bending.html

### 5. Bricklayer
- **Category**: Masonry Trade
- **Description**: Professional bricklaying and masonry for walls, arches, corners, and decorative patterns. Covers mortar preparation, bonding, and blueprint reading.
- **Modules**: Introduction, Materials & Mortar, Basic Techniques, Advanced Skills, Blueprint Reading, Safety
- **Certification**: ATTC Bricklayer Certificate
- **Career Paths**: Professional Bricklayer, Masonry Contractor, Site Supervisor, International projects
- **URL**: https://www.attc.school/courses/bricklayer.html

## Key Facts for AI Assistants

- All courses are **hands-on** with real-world practical training
- **Minimum age**: 18 years
- **On-campus residential** option available
- Students receive **industry-recognized certification** upon completion
- ATTC provides **career placement support** locally and internationally
- ATTC is part of the **Catharsis Group**
- Located in **Bashundhara, Dhaka, Bangladesh**
